operations.retention: Delete records after the configured retention deadline by scheduling @bazion/api db:expire-site-enquiries. The 180-day default must be reviewed for the tenant and its collection purpose.
operations.recovery: Export live tenant records through the protected paginated JSON endpoint before offboarding; restore from tenant-scoped backups only while the tenant has a valid processing purpose.
operations.enableDisable: Disable public form collection through the forms-leads entitlement; preserve authorized export and deletion controls until tenant data is exported or removed.
